entries.note: Agen mengirim data tata letak, lalu aplikasi merendernya dengan komponennya sendiri. Ada paket React, Angular, dan Lit. Masih versi 0.x.
entries.fit_en: Apps whose interface is composed by an AI agent
entries.note_en: The agent streams layout data, and the app renders it with its own components. There are React, Angular, and Lit packages. Still on version 0.x.
entries.desc: Open-source generative UI framework: agents stream layout data, and apps render it with native components in React, Angular, Lit, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.

entries.name: Reka UI
entries.fit: Dasar design system sendiri di Vue
entries.note: Dulu bernama Radix Vue. Komponen headless yang aksesibel, dipakai banyak library Vue lain.
entries.fit_en: The base for your own design system in Vue
entries.note_en: Formerly Radix Vue. Accessible headless components, used by many other Vue libraries.
entries.desc: An open-source UI component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps for Vue. Previously Radix Vue

entries.name: PrimeVue
entries.fit: Aplikasi bisnis dengan banyak komponen data
entries.note: Dari ekosistem Prime (PrimeNG, PrimeReact). Set komponen Vue yang sangat lengkap.
entries.fit_en: Business apps with lots of data components
entries.note_en: From the Prime ecosystem (PrimeNG, PrimeReact). A very complete set of Vue components.
entries.desc: Next Generation Vue UI Component Library

entries.name: Element Plus
entries.note: Library UI Vue 3 dari tim Element. Salah satu yang paling banyak diunduh di ekosistem Vue.
entries.fit_en: Admin panels and dashboards in Vue 3
entries.note_en: The Vue 3 UI library from the Element team. One of the most downloaded in the Vue ecosystem.
entries.desc: A Vue.js 3 UI Library made by Element team

entries.name: Vant
entries.note: Ringan dan bisa disesuaikan. Dari Youzan.
entries.note_en: Lightweight and customizable. From Youzan.
entries.desc: A lightweight, customizable Vue UI library for mobile web apps.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.fit: Svelte dengan design system berbasis Tailwind
entries.note: Sistem desain adaptif yang digerakkan Tailwind CSS.
entries.fit_en: Svelte with a Tailwind-based design system
entries.note_en: An adaptive design system powered by Tailwind CSS.
entries.desc: Skeleton is an adaptive design system powered by Tailwind CSS.

entries.name: PrimeNG
entries.fit: Aplikasi bisnis dengan banyak komponen data di Angular
entries.note: Set komponen Angular yang sangat lengkap dari ekosistem Prime. Lisensi di GitHub tercatat NOASSERTION, baca LICENSE.md sebelum dipakai komersial.
entries.fit_en: Business apps with lots of data components in Angular
entries.note_en: A very complete set of Angular components from the Prime ecosystem. The license is listed as NOASSERTION on GitHub, so read LICENSE.md before using it commercially.
entries.desc: The Most Complete Angular UI Component Library

entries.name: NG-ZORRO
entries.note: Implementasi Ant Design untuk Angular.
entries.fit_en: Admin and enterprise apps in Angular
entries.note_en: The Ant Design implementation for Angular.
entries.desc: Angular UI Component Library based on Ant Design

entries.name: Angular Material
entries.note: Dari tim Angular. Repo yang sama juga berisi CDK untuk membangun komponen sendiri.
entries.note_en: From the Angular team. The same repo also holds the CDK for building your own components.
entries.desc: Component infrastructure and Material Design components for Angular

entries.name: Bits UI
entries.fit: Dasar design system sendiri di Svelte
entries.note: Komponen headless untuk Svelte. Dipakai shadcn-svelte.
entries.fit_en: The base for your own design system in Svelte
entries.note_en: Headless components for Svelte. Used by shadcn-svelte.
entries.desc: The headless components for Svelte.

entries.name: shadcn-svelte
entries.note: Port shadcn/ui untuk Svelte. Kode disalin ke proyek.
entries.fit_en: Svelte products with the shadcn look
entries.note_en: A port of shadcn/ui for Svelte. The code is copied into your project.
entries.desc: shadcn/ui, but for Svelte.

entries.name: Vuetify
entries.note: Framework komponen Vue yang paling mapan. Lisensi MIT menurut npm, GitHub tidak mendeteksinya.
entries.note_en: The most established Vue component framework. MIT licensed according to npm, though GitHub does not detect it.
entries.desc: Vue Component Framework

entries.name: Quasar
entries.fit: Satu basis kode untuk web, mobile, dan desktop
entries.note: Framework berbasis Vue yang mencakup komponen sekaligus build tool.
entries.fit_en: One codebase for web, mobile, and desktop
entries.note_en: A Vue-based framework that covers both components and the build tooling.
entries.desc: Quasar Framework - Build high-performance VueJS user interfaces in record time

entries.name: Nuxt UI
entries.fit: Proyek Nuxt dan Vue dengan Tailwind
entries.note: Komponen siap pakai dari tim Nuxt, dibangun di atas Reka UI dan Tailwind.
entries.fit_en: Nuxt and Vue projects with Tailwind
entries.note_en: Ready-made components from the Nuxt team, built on Reka UI and Tailwind.
entries.desc: The Intuitive Vue UI Library powered by Reka UI & Tailwind CSS.

entries.name: Naive UI
entries.note: Library komponen Vue 3 yang ditulis dengan TypeScript.
entries.note_en: A Vue 3 component library written in TypeScript.
entries.desc: A Vue 3 Component Library. Fairly Complete. Theme Customizable. Uses TypeScript. Fast.

entries.name: Material Web
entries.note: Komponen Material 3 sebagai web components, dari Google.
entries.fit_en: Material Design 3 without a specific framework
entries.note_en: Material 3 components as web components, from Google.
entries.desc: Material Design Web Components

entries.name: Spectrum Web Components
entries.fit: Produk bergaya Adobe Spectrum tanpa framework tertentu
entries.note: Dari Adobe. Dipecah per komponen, jadi angka unduhan npm tidak ditampilkan.
entries.fit_en: Adobe Spectrum-style products without a specific framework
entries.note_en: From Adobe. Split into one package per component, so npm download numbers are not shown.
entries.desc: Spectrum Web Components

entries.name: Carbon Components Svelte
entries.fit: Enterprise bergaya IBM Carbon di Svelte
entries.note: Implementasi Svelte untuk Carbon Design System.
entries.fit_en: IBM Carbon-style enterprise apps in Svelte
entries.note_en: The Svelte implementation of the Carbon Design System.
entries.desc: Svelte implementation of the Carbon Design System

entries.name: Flowbite Svelte
entries.note: Versi Svelte dari Flowbite. Situs resminya membatasi pengecekan otomatis (HTTP 429), jadi tautan demo belum diverifikasi dari sisi kami.
entries.note_en: The Svelte version of Flowbite. Its official site rate-limits automated checks (HTTP 429), so we have not verified the demo link.
entries.desc: Official Svelte components built for Flowbite and Tailwind CSS

entries.name: Flowbite
entries.fit: Tailwind dengan HTML biasa, tanpa framework
entries.note: Komponen berbasis Tailwind CSS dan HTML. Ada juga versi React dan Svelte.
entries.fit_en: Tailwind with plain HTML, no framework needed
entries.note_en: Components based on Tailwind CSS and HTML. There are also React and Svelte versions.
entries.desc: Open-source UI component library and front-end development framework based on Tailwind CSS

entries.name: Calcite Design System
entries.fit: Aplikasi peta dan data geospasial (ekosistem ArcGIS)
entries.note: Dari Esri. Stars kecil tapi unduhan npm tinggi. Lisensi di GitHub tercatat NOASSERTION, baca LICENSE.md sebelum dipakai.
entries.note_en: From Esri. Few stars but high npm downloads. The license is listed as NOASSERTION on GitHub, so read LICENSE.md before using it.
entries.desc: A monorepo containing the packages for Esri's Calcite Design System

entries.name: Hugeicons
entries.fit: Butuh set besar dengan satu gaya garis bulat
entries.note: Yang tampil di sini versi gratis: 6.000+ ikon gaya Stroke Rounded. Versi Pro berbayar punya 60.000+ ikon dalam 10 gaya.
entries.fit_en: You want a large set in one rounded line style
entries.note_en: What appears here is the free version: 6,000+ icons in Stroke Rounded. The paid Pro version has 60,000+ icons in 10 styles.
entries.desc: Beautiful, consistent, pixel-perfect icons for every framework. 60,000+ icons (6,000+ free) for React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, React Native, Flutter and more.

entries.name: Cloudflare Kumo
entries.note: Library komponen dari Cloudflare, dibangun di atas Base UI. Masih versi baru dan berkembang cepat.
entries.fit_en: Web apps in the Cloudflare dashboard style
entries.note_en: Cloudflare's component library, built on Base UI. Still new and moving fast.
entries.desc: Cloudflare's component library for building modern web applications.

entries.name: Taiga UI
entries.note: Dibagi beberapa paket (core, kit, dan lainnya). Butuh Angular 19 atau lebih baru.
entries.fit_en: Angular apps with a complete set of components
entries.note_en: Split into several packages (core, kit, and more). Requires Angular 19 or newer.
entries.desc: Angular components library for awesome people

entries.name: Varlet
entries.fit: Aplikasi mobile dan desktop di Vue 3
entries.note: Berbasis Material Design 2 dan 3. Unduhan npm kecil, tapi stars tinggi.
entries.fit_en: Mobile and desktop apps in Vue 3
entries.note_en: Based on Material Design 2 and 3. Small npm downloads, but plenty of stars.
entries.desc: A Vue3 component library based on Material Design 2 and 3, supporting mobile and desktop.

entries.name: Arco Design Vue
entries.note: Versi Vue dari Arco Design milik ByteDance. Pasangan Arco Design untuk React yang sudah ada di katalog.
entries.note_en: The Vue version of ByteDance's Arco Design. The counterpart of the React Arco Design already in the catalog.
entries.desc: A Vue.js 3 UI Library based on Arco Design

entries.name: React Native UI Lib
entries.fit: Aplikasi React Native dengan komponen siap pakai
entries.note: Dari Wix. Komponen untuk React Native, bukan untuk web.
entries.fit_en: React Native apps with ready-made components
entries.note_en: From Wix. Components for React Native, not for the web.
entries.desc: UI Components Library for React Native

entries.name: Primer CSS
entries.fit: Gaya GitHub dengan HTML dan CSS biasa
entries.note: Implementasi CSS dari design system GitHub. Untuk versi React, lihat Primer React.
entries.fit_en: The GitHub look with plain HTML and CSS
entries.note_en: The CSS implementation of GitHub's design system. For the React version, see Primer React.
entries.desc: Primer is GitHub's design system. This is the CSS implementation

entries.name: Amplify UI
entries.fit: Aplikasi yang memakai AWS Amplify (login, penyimpanan, dan lainnya)
entries.note: Dari AWS. Ada paket untuk React, Vue, Angular, dan React Native. Komponennya bisa terhubung langsung ke layanan cloud AWS.
entries.fit_en: Apps built on AWS Amplify (sign-in, storage, and more)
entries.note_en: From AWS. There are packages for React, Vue, Angular, and React Native. The components can connect directly to AWS cloud services.
entries.desc: Amplify UI is a collection of accessible, themeable, performant React (and more!) components that can connect directly to the cloud.

entries.name: MUI X
entries.fit: Aplikasi data berat: tabel, tanggal, dan chart
entries.note: Tambahan untuk Material UI (Data Grid, Date Pickers, Charts). Versi Pro dan Premium berlisensi komersial. Lisensi di GitHub tidak terdeteksi.
entries.fit_en: Data-heavy apps: tables, dates, and charts
entries.note_en: An add-on for Material UI (Data Grid, Date Pickers, Charts). The Pro and Premium versions have a commercial license. The license is not detected on GitHub.
entries.desc: MUI X: Build complex and data-rich applications using a growing list of advanced React components, like the Data Grid, Date and Time Pickers, Charts, and more!

entries.name: Radix Themes
entries.fit: Komponen berbasis Radix yang sudah bergaya
entries.note: Dibangun di atas Radix Primitives. Update melambat, tapi unduhan npm masih tinggi.
entries.note_en: Built on Radix Primitives. Updates have slowed down, but npm downloads are still high.
entries.desc: Radix Themes is an open-source component library optimized for fast development, easy maintenance, and accessibility. Maintained by @workos.

entries.name: ElevenLabs UI
entries.note: Registry komponen di atas shadcn/ui, disalin ke proyek. Tidak ada paket npm sendiri, jadi unduhan tidak ditampilkan.
entries.warn: Situs resmi memblokir pengecekan otomatis (HTTP 429) saat dicek 18 Nov 2026. Di browser biasa biasanya terbuka, tapi belum kami verifikasi.
entries.note_en: A component registry on top of shadcn/ui, copied into your project. It has no npm package of its own, so downloads are not shown.
entries.warn_en: The official site blocked automated checks (HTTP 429) on Nov 18, 2026. It usually opens in a regular browser, but we have not verified that.
entries.desc: ElevenLabs UI is a component library and custom registry built on top of shadcn/ui to help you build multimodal agents faster.

entries.name: Basecoat
entries.fit: Proyek tanpa framework JavaScript, cukup HTML dan Tailwind
entries.note: Komponen berbasis Tailwind CSS yang jalan di stack web apa pun.
entries.fit_en: Projects without a JavaScript framework, just HTML and Tailwind
entries.note_en: Components built with Tailwind CSS that work with any web stack.
entries.desc: A components library built with Tailwind CSS that works with any web stack.

entries.name: Oruga
entries.fit: Vue dengan framework CSS pilihan sendiri
entries.note: Komponen Vue ringan tanpa ketergantungan CSS, jadi gayanya dari framework CSS yang kamu pilih.
entries.fit_en: Vue with the CSS framework of your choice
entries.note_en: Lightweight Vue components with no CSS dependency, so the look comes from the CSS framework you pick.
entries.desc: Oruga is a lightweight Vue.js UI component library without any CSS dependency

entries.name: Zard UI
entries.note: Dibuat berdasarkan shadcn/ui dan NG-ZORRO. Tidak ada paket npm sendiri, jadi unduhan tidak ditampilkan.
entries.note_en: Based on shadcn/ui and NG-ZORRO. It has no npm package of its own, so downloads are not shown.
entries.desc: A collection of beautiful and accessible components for Angular based in Shadcn/ui and Ng-zorro. Fully open source and free

entries.name: Kokonut UI
entries.fit: Komponen animasi siap salin di atas shadcn/ui
entries.note: Koleksi komponen dengan Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, dan Motion. Tidak ada paket npm, jadi unduhan tidak ditampilkan.
entries.fit_en: Copy-ready animated components on top of shadcn/ui
entries.note_en: A collection of components built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Motion. There is no npm package, so downloads are not shown.
entries.desc: Open-source collection of stunning Components built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Motion to use on your websites

entries.name: UI Kitten
entries.fit: Aplikasi React Native dengan Eva Design System
entries.note: Dibangun di atas Eva Design System, dengan 30+ komponen yang bisa ditema untuk iOS, Android, dan web.
entries.fit_en: React Native apps with the Eva Design System
entries.note_en: Built on the Eva Design System, with 30+ themeable components for iOS, Android, and web.
entries.desc: React Native UI library built on the Eva Design System: 30+ themeable, accessible components for iOS, Android and web. TypeScript, React 19 / RN 0.81, Eva and Material themes with runtime light/dark switching, on-demand style compilation.

entries.name: Fusion Design
entries.note: Library komponen React yang bisa dikonfigurasi, dari Alibaba.
entries.fit_en: Enterprise apps in the Alibaba style
entries.note_en: A configurable React component library from Alibaba.
entries.desc: A configurable component library for web built on React.

entries.name: React Bits
entries.fit: Efek dan animasi interaktif untuk halaman
entries.note: Salah satu repo dengan bintang terbanyak di katalog ini, tapi kami tidak menemukan paket npm resminya.
entries.warn: Lisensinya MIT dengan Commons Clause, yang membatasi penjualan komponen sebagai produk. Baca LICENSE sebelum dipakai komersial. Paket npm bernama react-bits adalah proyek lain.
entries.fit_en: Interactive effects and animation for pages
entries.note_en: One of the repos with the most stars in this catalog, but we found no official npm package for it.
entries.warn_en: The license is MIT with the Commons Clause, which restricts selling the components as a product. Read LICENSE before commercial use. The npm package named react-bits is a different project.
entries.desc: The largest open-source library of animated, interactive, and customizable React & Next.js components for building standout web products and experiences. Built for humans and AI agents.

entries.name: Motion Primitives
entries.note: Kit komponen animasi yang bisa disesuaikan. Paket npm-nya masih versi 0.1.0.
entries.note_en: A customizable animated UI kit. Its npm package is still on version 0.1.0.
entries.desc: UI kit to make beautiful, animated interfaces, faster. Customizable. Open Source.

entries.name: AI Elements Vue
entries.note: Pasangan Vue untuk AI Elements, dibangun di atas shadcn-vue. Berkas lisensi di repo Apache-2.0, tapi metadata npm menyebut MIT.
entries.note_en: The Vue counterpart of AI Elements, built on shadcn-vue. The license file in the repo is Apache-2.0, but the npm metadata says MIT.
entries.desc: AI Elements Vue is a component library built on top of shadcn-vue to help you build AI-native applications faster.

entries.name: Inkline
entries.fit: Aplikasi Vue 3 dan Nuxt dengan fondasi komponen lengkap
entries.note: Library komponen untuk Vue 3 dengan fokus pengalaman developer.
entries.warn: Repo tidak punya berkas lisensi. Hanya metadata npm yang menyebut MIT, jadi hak pakai belum jelas. Pastikan ke pengelola sebelum dipakai komersial.
entries.fit_en: Vue 3 and Nuxt apps with a complete component foundation
entries.note_en: A component library for Vue 3 with a focus on developer experience.
entries.warn_en: The repo has no license file. Only the npm metadata says MIT, so usage rights are not clear. Check with the maintainers before commercial use.
entries.desc: Inkline is the intuitive UI Components library that gives you a developer-friendly foundation for building high-quality, accessible, and customizable Vue.js 3 Design Systems.

entries.name: Ant Design Web3
entries.note: Komponen untuk menghubungkan dompet kripto dan membangun dApp. Butuh Ant Design (antd) 5 atau lebih baru.
entries.note_en: Components for connecting crypto wallets and building dApps. Requires Ant Design (antd) 5 or newer.
entries.desc: Efficient react components for building dapps easier | Connect crypto wallets and more Web3 UI components | Web3 icons | Supports Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, TON, Sui, TRON and others.

entries.name: Onsen UI
entries.note: Framework dan SDK untuk aplikasi mobile lintas platform, dengan paket terpisah untuk React, Vue, dan Angular. GitHub tidak mencatat lisensi, npm menyebut Apache-2.0.
entries.note_en: A framework and SDK for cross-platform mobile apps, with separate packages for React, Vue, and Angular. GitHub lists no license, while npm says Apache-2.0.
entries.desc: Mobile app development framework and SDK using HTML5 and JavaScript. Create beautiful and performant cross-platform mobile apps. Based on Web Components, and provides bindings for Angular 1, 2, React and Vue.js.

entries.name: Animal Island UI
entries.note: Library komponen React bergaya kawaii.
entries.note_en: A React component library in a kawaii style.
entries.desc: A Kawaii React UI component library 一个可爱的 React UI 组件库

entries.name: React95
entries.note: Gambar dan merek Windows milik Microsoft dan tidak tercakup lisensi MIT proyek ini.
entries.note_en: Windows images and trademarks belong to Microsoft and are not covered by this project's MIT license.
entries.desc: A React components library with Win95 UI

entries.name: Devicon
entries.fit: Logo bahasa pemrograman dan alat developer
entries.note: Kebanyakan logo berwarna asli, bukan satu warna. Logo milik pemiliknya masing-masing.
entries.warn: Hanya logo teknologi. Pakai sesuai pedoman merek masing-masing.
entries.fit_en: Logos of programming languages and developer tools
entries.note_en: Most logos keep their original colors rather than a single color. The logos belong to their respective owners.
entries.warn_en: Technology logos only. Use them according to each brand's guidelines.
entries.desc: Set of icons representing programming languages, designing & development tools
